description: This Java class 'SmwSelectionStep' is a UI component for an SDK package selection wizard page in Android development tools. It displays installed and available SDK packages, allows user interaction for installation, update, or removal, and manages SDK state updates.

classes.name: SmwSelectionStep
classes.description: A wizard step UI component for selecting SDK packages, managing SDK state, and user interactions for install/update/removal.

classes.name: SdkStateNeededAction
classes.description: A UI action to perform SDK state-dependent operations like install or uninstall.

classes.name: RefreshAction
classes.description: A specific action to refresh the SDK package list.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the step is disposed.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component for this wizard step.

methods.name: createUIComponents
methods.description: Initializes custom UI components, notably the package selection table.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the step when it becomes visible, sets up SDK data, UI actions, and loads SDK info asynchronously.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the label used for displaying description or error info.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the label used for displaying error messages.

methods.name: _commit
methods.description: Saves the user's selected actions when moving forward in the wizard.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current selection before proceeding.

methods.name: onTableSelection
methods.description: Updates package details display based on table selection.

methods.name: getActionGroup
methods.description: Creates the toolbar actions for refresh, install, and uninstall.
